g.text: From forecast changes to wind stress and local advection
Common event calendar; shaded months mark JAS. No PMM-attributed wind or current has been estimated.
Top: all five February–June forecasts, retained within development year; scoring remains common center leads 1–5.
Middle: ERA5 monthly stress, 5°S–5°N, 160°E–140°W, inherited 1982–2022 anomaly baseline. Positive = eastward anomaly.
Bottom: Niño3.4 process terms, target-excluded monthly-mean background. Distinct baselines/variables are not quantitatively equated.
